source.title: Lyca - Keeper of Glades
source.name: Lyca
source.description: A Marksman who is skilled at lowering enemy's Phys DEF and imbuing buffs to allies.

skills.name: Comet Archery

description.raw: Lyca fires a comet-like arrow in a chosen direction, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 5 tiles along its path and leaving Nebula Reflection for 7s. The allies under Nebula Reflection summon meteors to deal extra damage equal to 50% of their ATK to the target while using normal attacks.
active: Lyca fires a comet-like arrow in a chosen direction, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 5 tiles along its path and leaving Nebula Reflection for 7s.
The allies under Nebula Reflection summon meteors to deal extra damage equal to 50% of their ATK to the target while using normal attacks.

skills.description_lite: Lyca fires a comet-like arrow, dealing damage to enemies in its path. Allies within range summon meteors with their normal attacks, dealing extra damage to the target.

skills.name: Empyrean Blessing

description.raw: Lyca bestows blessings of the stars, increasing all allies' ATK SPD by 25 + 5 (SP-based) for 6s. This effect is triggered immediately when a battle starts and grants all allies 120 Energy.
active: Lyca bestows blessings of the stars, increasing all allies' ATK SPD by 25 + 5 (SP-based) for 6s.
This effect is triggered immediately when a battle starts and grants all allies 120 Energy.

skills.description_lite: Lyca bestows blessings of the stars on all allies, increasing their ATK SPD. She also grants them extra Energy on the first cast.

skills.name: Nova Fall

description.raw: Lyca summons meteors to attack all enemies, dealing 100% (ATK-based) damage and reducing their Phys DEF by 10% for 5s + 1.5 (SP-based)s.
active: Lyca summons meteors to attack all enemies, dealing 100% (ATK-based) damage and reducing their Phys DEF by 10% for 5s + 1.5 (SP-based)s.

skills.description_lite: Lyca summons meteors to attack all enemies, reducing their Phys DEF.

description.raw: Increases ATK SPD by 21 during battle.
active: Increases ATK SPD by 21 during battle.

text: Increases ATK SPD by 27 during battle.
Increases ATK SPD by 33 during battle.

skills.name: Meteor Catastrophe

description.raw: Lyca summons meteors when a battle starts, directing them to attack targets with her normal attacks, dealing 40% (ATK-based) physical damage.
active: Lyca summons meteors when a battle starts, directing them to attack targets with her normal attacks, dealing 40% (ATK-based) physical damage.

text: Shoots an aerolite at a shielded enemy, dealing 350% (ATK-based) damage.
If the shield breaks, the target is stunned for 4s.
Only 1 aerolite can be shot every 10s.

skills.description_lite: Lyca summons meteors to assist in battle.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Lyca reduces the target's Phys DEF by 25% for 6s if they are hit by Comet Archery.
active: Lyca reduces the target's Phys DEF by 25% for 6s if they are hit by Comet Archery.

skills.description_lite: Lyca reduces the target's Phys DEF if they are hit by Comet Archery.
